Overview

Tilburg is a city in North Brabant with a population of 229,836. A former textile hub turned modern Brabant city with a growing creative sector, strong logistics industry, and a more affordable, laid-back lifestyle. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
